title: Escape Pod
caption: Escape Pod (V)
game_text: ▲ a dejarik, hologram, or holosite. OR Cancel a Force drain at a holosite. OR If opponent is about to place your character out of play, place that character in your Lost Pile instead.
lore: Capital starships have emergency escape pods. Equipped with food, water, flares, medpacs, hunting blaster and tracking beacon (R2-D2 deactivated this one’s beacon).
